refresh_guidance: Review when Treasury releases a new LTFM or materially updates BEFU/HYEFU macro assumptions.
Review annually when IRD updates the taxable-income distribution workbook.
Review when Stats NZ releases a replacement family and household projection base.
Review with each annual Labour Market Statistics income release.
Review when Stats NZ issues a newer complete period life-table workbook.
For each annual NZS-rate refresh, use the last QES release before 1 March of the rate year.
Refresh if MSD provides a newer recipient payment-rate composition.
Refresh when MSD publishes a comparable transfer-flow response or administrative series.
Review when the underlying supplementary-assistance evidence is superseded.
Review every April before accepting a refreshed benefit-assumption calibration.
